senses.nuances: pos 的 noun 在此表示专有名词。姓氏正常写作 Barden；其姓氏用法见 [Ancestry 姓氏资料](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Barden)。该资料不能确定输入语料中的实际指称，也不能证明其为官方马来语词条。音标、分音节和爪夷文保持未核实状态。下列搭配为姓氏使用结构，例句人物为虚构；马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 引文。

etymology.historical_story: Surname references associate an English Barden lineage with place names including Barden Park, Bardown and Berden. This illustrates how a geographical label can become a family name. It does not establish the ancestry of every bearer, or identify what the lowercase token means in an unspecified Malay source. A single origin therefore cannot be assigned here. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Barden)
